proposal.hypothesis: Both delayed degraded Missions move backward before impact. Integrating gait phase from the observable signed progress deficit, and continuously slowing it toward 0.35 rate instead of latching a direction, should reduce that backward entry state without selecting an impact side or discontinuously jumping phase.
proposal.expectedEffect: Improve pre-impact signed progress in both degraded Cases while preserving exact Cases and introducing no collision, joint-limit, command, or recovery regression.
